# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We want participation in this profile repository and its discussions to be welcoming and respectful to everyone, regardless of background or experience.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and constructive.
- Share feedback with care and focus on the work.
- Respect privacy; do not publish personal or confidential information.
- Keep discussions relevant to the profile, its projects, and documentation.

## Unacceptable Behavior

Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, doxxing, and other unprofessional conduct are not acceptable.

## Reporting

Report conduct concerns privately through the LinkedIn contact path in the [profile README](../README.md). Reports will be reviewed as promptly and respectfully as possible.
